stem: A circle has radius {=r} cm. A straight line is an axis of symmetry of the circle and cuts the circle at two points $A$ and $B$. Find the length of $AB$ in cm.
solution: An axis of symmetry of a circle is a straight line through the centre $O$.
So $A$, $O$ and $B$ lie on one straight line, and $AB$ is a diameter.
notes: Advanced: uses the rule to deduce the line cuts the circle in a diameter, any axis gives the same length.
